title: PersonaScienceBench: Evaluating Scientific Agents with Diverse Simulated Researchers
title_zh: PersonaScienceBench：用多样化模拟研究者评估科学智能体

paragraphs.en: Scientific agents collaborate with researchers whose expertise and preferences differ, but benchmarks usually hold the collaborator fixed. We introduce PersonaScienceBench: 200 tasks from five benchmarks across four scientific domains. Simulated researchers provide context and feedback according to persona profiles, while task objectives and grading remain fixed. Agents encounter researcher preferences only through conversation. Across eighteen model configurations, task performance, fact recovery, and self-repetition reveal different strengths. Detailed GPT-6 Astra analyses show distinct agent responses across researcher profiles; interaction traces illustrate targeted clarification and workflow revision. These behaviors can differ even when final scores match. PersonaScienceBench therefore evaluates how agents collaborate with diverse researchers alongside whether they complete the task.
paragraphs.zh: 科学智能体需要与专业领域和偏好各不相同的研究者协作，但现有基准通常将协作者固定不变。 我们提出 PersonaScienceBench：该基准包含来自四个科学领域中五个基准的 200 个任务。 模拟研究者根据角色画像提供背景信息和反馈，而任务目标与评分标准保持不变。 智能体只能通过对话来了解研究者的偏好。 在十八种模型配置中，任务表现、事实回忆和自我重复展现出不同的优势。 对 GPT-6 Astra 的详细分析显示，智能体对不同研究者画像会做出截然不同的回应；交互轨迹展示了针对性的澄清与工作流调整。 即使最终得分相同，这些行为也可能存在差异。 因此，PersonaScienceBench 不仅评估智能体能否完成任务，还评估它们如何与不同研究者协作。

paragraphs.en: Language-model agents now perform substantial parts of the scientific workflow. They search literature, propose hypotheses, write and execute analysis code, and assemble results into reports Lu et al. (2024) ; Yamada et al. (2025) ; Gottweis et al. (2026) ; Mitchener et al. (2025b) . The benchmarks used to measure this progress have followed the same trajectory, moving from recall and reasoning questions toward executable analysis tasks drawn from real studies Majumder et al. (2025) ; Mitchener et al. (2025a) ; Kon et al. (2026) ; Ye et al. (2025) . These capabilities do not remove the need for human collaboration, and recent work questions their suitability for unsupervised discovery Bisht et al. (2026) . Researchers often hold context that determines whether an analysis is valid: why samples were excluded, whether a covariate is confounded with batch, or which normalization a laboratory uses. Such information may be absent from the data directory. An agent’s scientific output can therefore depend on how it consults a researcher who may explain readily, answer only the literal question, or misremember a detail.

paragraphs.en: We introduce PersonaScienceBench, which varies the simulated researcher on fixed scientific tasks (Figure 1 ). We convert 200 tasks from DiscoveryBench Majumder et al. (2025) , BixBench Mitchener et al. (2025a) , EXP-Bench Kon et al. (2026) , SciConvBench Somasekharan et al. (2026) , and ASI-Bench Zhou et al. (2026) into collaborative tasks with clarification or review while preserving source-specific deliverables and grading. The researcher receives a complete rendered MatrAIx profile Li et al. (2026) : an auditable attribute–value listing, typically containing roughly 200 populated attributes from a schema of 1,290 categorical dimensions. Only the researcher simulator receives this identity block; the actor observes researcher preferences through conversation, and evaluator references remain private. In the persona-off condition, the simulator receives no persona profile; all other instructions remain unchanged. Section 4.1 specifies the single-trial protocol and uncertainty estimates for these comparisons.

paragraphs.en: We assess scientific outcomes and interaction behavior separately (Figure 1 c). Source-specific graders measure task performance; interaction metrics capture review rounds, revisions, clarification, message length, and language adaptation. Together, they distinguish successful completion from intermediate progress, such as recovering missing information in an episode that still ends unsuccessfully. They also reveal changes in collaboration that a final score alone can miss.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分别评估科学产出与交互行为（图1 c）。 针对不同来源的评分器衡量任务表现；交互指标则捕捉评审轮次、修改次数、澄清情况、消息长度以及语言适配。 两者结合，可以区分成功完成与中间进展，例如在某一轮对话中找回了缺失信息但最终仍未成功的情形。 它们还能揭示仅凭最终分数可能遗漏的协作变化。

paragraphs.en: Language Models with Personas. Conditioning language models on persona descriptions can produce varied responses and simulated user behavior Argyle et al. (2023) ; Ge et al. (2024) . Recent work develops persona generators for user coverage and applies persona-based simulation to interactive-system evaluation Paglieri et al. (2026) ; Liu et al. (2026) . Non-collaborative user simulators and Persona Policies further show that varying user behavior can change tool-agent performance in service domains Shim et al. (2026) ; Chopra et al. (2026) . MatrAIx provides structured profiles spanning background, capability, and behavior Li et al. (2026) . We use these profiles to study simulated scientific collaborators, comparing persona-conditioned interactions with a persona-off control while holding scientific tasks and interaction protocols fixed.

(2026)。 我们利用这些画像来研究模拟的科研协作者，在保持科学任务和交互协议不变的情况下，将有 persona 条件下的交互与无 persona 的对照组进行比较。

paragraphs.en: We draw simulated researcher profiles from the public Persona8B coreset released by MatrAIx Li et al. (2026) . Its underlying population uses a schema of 1,290 categorical dimensions spanning background, psychology, capability, interaction, and lifestyle. MatrAIx constructs records through two pathways. Synthetic records are sampled in topological order from a directed acyclic dependency graph: source-informed categorical priors and conditional adjustments preserve selected correlations, while compatibility rules exclude specified contradictions. Human-grounded records map biographies, review histories, coded surveys, and consented self-reports into the same schema; fields without source support remain unassigned. Both paths undergo source-appropriate quality checks and deduplication. The released coreset contains 599,847 human-grounded and 400,000 synthetic records. This construction provides varied, inspectable identity prompts; it does not establish that a simulated collaborator represents a particular real researcher or a population subgroup.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 MatrAIx（Li et al. (2026)）公开发布的 Persona8B 核心数据集中抽取模拟研究者档案。 其底层人群采用包含 1,290 个类别维度的模式，涵盖背景、心理、能力、互动与生活方式。 MatrAIx 通过两条途径构建记录。 合成记录按照拓扑顺序从一个有向无环依赖图中采样：基于来源的类别先验和条件调整保留了选定的相关性，而兼容性规则则排除了指定的矛盾。 以人类为依据的记录将传记、审稿历史、编码调查以及经同意的自我报告映射到同一模式中；缺乏来源支持的字段保持未赋值状态。 两条途径都经过与来源相适应的质量检查和去重。 发布的核心数据集包含 599,847 条以人类为依据的记录和 400,000 条合成记录。 这种构建提供了多样且可查验的身份提示；它并不能证明某个模拟智能体代表某位特定的真实研究者或某个亚人群。

paragraphs.en: We select four coreset profiles using a coverage-based strategy over communication, decision-making, interaction, tool-collaboration, and workflow attributes. Together with persona off, they define the five settings used throughout the evaluation. For each selected record, the pinned MatrAIx renderer emits every retained populated attribute as a category-grouped attribute–value identity block; null, placeholder, schema-default, and designated source-dump fields are omitted. We inject this complete rendered block into the researcher simulator’s system prompt, without task-specific pruning or summarization. The actor and evaluator never receive it. The persona-off condition uses the same simulator and interaction protocol with the identity block removed. Scientific task facts and grading criteria are held fixed across conditions (Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在沟通、决策、交互、工具协作与工作流属性上采用基于覆盖率的策略，选取四个核心集配置（coreset profiles）。 它们与关闭人格（persona off）共同构成了整个评估中使用的五种设置。 对于每条被选中的记录，固定的 MatrAIx 渲染器会将每个保留的非空属性输出为一个按类别分组的属性–值身份块；空值、占位符、模式默认值以及指定的源数据转储字段会被省略。 我们将这个完整的渲染块注入研究模拟器的系统提示词中，不做任何针对任务的剪裁或摘要。 智能体（actor）和评估器永远不会收到它。 关闭人格的条件使用相同的模拟器和交互协议，但移除了身份块。 科学任务事实与评分标准在各条件下保持不变（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: We adapt scientific tasks so that an actor must work with a simulated researcher, exposing decisions that final-answer evaluation alone does not capture. Conversion separates public inputs, researcher context, and private evaluation, and defines when the agents interact to share information (Algorithm 1 ). Required checkpoints are distinguished from voluntary clarification and revision; longer conversations are not rewarded.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate five settings: the four profiles in Table 1 and persona off. Only the researcher simulator receives the profile; persona off omits it while retaining the same interaction protocol. Every model is evaluated on the same 200 questions, comprising 40 from each benchmark, with one trial per question and setting. Thus each model has 1,000 task–setting episodes. For GPT-6 Astra, persona off and personas 155 and 001 were each run up to three times, and Astra’s performance estimates average the available trials for each task (Appendix B ). Tasks, scientific requirements, and grading criteria remain fixed across settings.

paragraphs.en: Across the eighteen reported model configurations, the difference between mean persona performance and persona-off performance varied in both direction and magnitude (Table 3 ). GPT-5 mini showed the largest observed increase, from 26.37 under persona off to 31.63 across the four personas, a difference of 5.26 points. paragraphs.en: The selected episodes also show targeted follow-up by the actor. The BixBench example involved more interaction iterations under every persona than under persona off. Such participation is valuable in scientific collaboration, where initial requests can leave consequential assumptions and preferences implicit. Continued dialogue gives the researcher and agent opportunities to make those choices explicit, resolve uncertainty, and incorporate feedback before committing to an approach.

paragraphs.en: Information recovery revealed progress during multi-turn scientific work, including in episodes that ultimately failed (Figure 5 B). paragraphs.en: PersonaScienceBench adapts 200 tasks from five scientific benchmarks for interaction with diverse simulated researchers, keeping objectives and grading fixed. Persona-conditioned interactions produced distinct responses, communication patterns, and workflows that final scores alone did not capture. Evaluating behavior alongside task performance captures adaptation to different researchers.
paragraphs.zh: PersonaScienceBench 将来自五个科学基准的 200 个任务改造用于与多样化的模拟研究人员交互，同时保持目标和评分标准不变。 基于人格条件化的交互产生了截然不同的回应、沟通模式和工作流程，而这些仅凭最终分数是无法体现的。 在任务表现之外同时评估行为，能够刻画智能体对不同研究人员的适应情况。

paragraphs.en: PersonaScienceBench covers 200 computational tasks involving text, data analysis, and code execution. It does not evaluate image processing, physical experiments, or extended projects involving multiple researchers. Collaboration is limited to bounded episodes with one actor and one simulated researcher. Results therefore describe the tested computational workflows and interaction protocols.
paragraphs.zh: PersonaScienceBench 涵盖 200 个涉及文本、数据分析和代码执行的计算任务。 它不评估图像处理、物理实验或涉及多名研究人员的长期扩展项目。 协作仅限于由一个智能体和一个模拟研究人员组成的、有明确边界的交互回合。 因此，结果描述的是经过测试的计算工作流和交互协议。

paragraphs.en: The four profiles are selected to span contrasting researcher attributes, not to represent the distribution of real researchers. Each profile combines many attributes, sometimes with internal inconsistencies; the comparisons cannot assign causal responsibility to a particular trait or demographic category. Semantic differences may reflect language, message length, and endpoint function as well as interaction content. The selected trajectories and discussion cases illustrate possible behaviors rather than their prevalence.
paragraphs.zh: 这四个档案的选取是为了覆盖对比鲜明的研究者属性，而非代表真实研究者的分布情况。 每个档案都结合了多种属性，有时内部还存在不一致之处；这些比较无法将因果关系归因于某一特定特征或人口统计类别。 语义差异可能反映了语言、消息长度和端点功能，以及交互内容。 所选取的轨迹和讨论案例展示的是可能的行为，而非这些行为的发生频率。

paragraphs.en: Each task and setting is evaluated once, except that GPT-6 Astra’s performance estimates average up to three available trials for persona off and personas 155 and 001. Bootstrap intervals characterize variation across sampled tasks or studies, conditional on the recorded trials; they do not quantify variability across independent rollouts. Actors and simulators use the same model within each configuration, so cross-model results characterize coupled systems rather than isolating actor capability. Model-based evaluations share GPT-6 Astra with low reasoning effort, but a common judge does not eliminate grading error. A simulated profile is not evidence of a faithful representation of a real researcher. Finally, lexical self-repetition and embedding separation capture different aspects of interaction; neither alone establishes semantic collapse, collaboration quality, or scientific validity.
paragraphs.zh: 除 GPT-6 Astra 的性能估计在 persona off 以及 persona 155 和 001 下会对最多三个可用试验取平均值外，每个任务和设置均只评估一次。 自举区间刻画的是在已记录试验条件下，跨抽样任务或研究的变异；它们并不量化跨独立 rollout 的变异性。 在每个配置中，执行者（actor）与模拟器使用相同的模型，因此跨模型的结果刻画的是耦合系统，而非孤立地衡量执行者的能力。 基于模型的评估共用低推理努力程度的 GPT-6 Astra，但使用共同的评判者并不能消除评分误差。 模拟出的画像并不能证明其对真实研究者的忠实再现。 最后，词汇层面的自我重复与嵌入分离刻画的是交互的不同方面；二者单独任一都不能确立语义坍缩、协作质量或科学有效性。

paragraphs.en: PersonaScienceBench uses simulated researcher profiles to study variation in human–agent interaction. These profiles should not be interpreted as faithful representations of specific people or demographic groups, and observed performance differences between profile conditions should not be used to rank or make decisions about real researchers. The benchmark is intended to evaluate agent robustness and adaptation across collaborator conditions.
paragraphs.zh: PersonaScienceBench 使用模拟的研究者画像来研究人—智能体交互中的差异性。 这些画像不应被解读为对特定个人或人群群体的忠实刻画，且在不同画像条件下观察到的性能差异不应被用于对真实研究者进行排名或做出决策。 该基准旨在评估智能体在不同协作者条件下的鲁棒性与适应能力。

paragraphs.en: Researcher simulators can produce incorrect or inappropriate scientific guidance. Although the benchmark separates grounded task context from optional advice and keeps evaluator references private, these controls do not guarantee that every generated statement is scientifically valid. Benchmark traces should therefore not be treated as scientific, medical, or operational guidance without independent expert review.
paragraphs.zh: 研究员模拟器可能产生不正确或不恰当的科学指导。 尽管该基准测试将有依据的任务上下文与可选建议分离开来，并对评估器参考内容保密，但这些控制措施并不能保证每一条生成的陈述在科学上都是有效的。 因此，未经独立专家审查，不应将基准测试轨迹视为科学、医疗或操作指导。

paragraphs.en: A solve-and-submit interface can measure the quality of a final scientific artifact without exposing how its producer negotiates assumptions, obtains context, or responds to criticism. Adding an optional question channel alone also permits an episode to finish without consulting the researcher. Our adaptation therefore gives the researcher an explicit role in reviewing proposed approaches and reported results. These checkpoints create opportunities to clarify a consequential choice, request evidence, or identify a revision before submission. The intended improvement is coverage of collaborative scientific work, rather than a guaranteed increase in accuracy or conversation length. A required handoff is a protocol event, not evidence of spontaneous actor initiative. Additional questions and revisions must be measured separately. SciConvBench already evaluates clarification, so it retains its native dialogue instead of receiving artificial approval interactions.

paragraphs.en: Each converted task retains its native identifier, source revision, study group, scientific objective, required deliverables, and an explicit evaluation contract. The public brief must expose the basic scope, permitted resources, access instructions, and submission format. Researcher-held requirements must be discoverable within the declared interaction budget. We do not remove arbitrary information or invent missing facts merely to induce questions. paragraphs.en: Conversion produces separate public inputs b b , researcher context k k , and evaluator configuration e e , together with interaction protocol π \pi . The actor receives the public brief, allowlisted files and tools, actual runtime information, and shared researcher replies. The researcher receives permitted task context, its persona, and the shared conversation, including actor-selected evidence. It does not automatically inspect private actor reasoning, tool logs, or unshared files. Reference answers, gold solution artifacts, and hidden tests remain evaluator-only; the controller manages versions, access, and records. Exporters select explicit fields and files rather than passing through entire source records or repositories. Access boundaries must hold in mounts and tool interfaces, not merely in filenames. Native labels or metadata that are legitimate task inputs may remain public. Source-context access is distinguished from access to an answer key.

paragraphs.en: Each extracted fact has a stable identifier, a source revision and path, and an inspectable locator, such as a field or text span. Automated extraction and validation are recorded as automated processing rather than human review. Reference material may be inspected during curation to detect leakage, but it is not used to synthesize the researcher’s runtime knowledge. The full-profile study permits general scientific knowledge and suggestions in persona-conditioned and persona-off settings. Such suggestions do not become new task requirements, and source-specific assertions still require grounding. A valid fact identifier does not independently verify every sentence of a generated reply. Claims about available files, packages, or hardware must match the actual runtime.

paragraphs.en: For execution and design tracks, the researcher first requests inspection of the inputs and a proposed approach. The researcher may request a revision for an identifiable mismatch or unresolved uncertainty, or conclude the episode. It is instructed to distinguish actor reports from independently verified findings and never to act as the final grader. There is no minimum quota of additional questions and no reward for extending the conversation.

paragraphs.en: The actor’s workspace and both roles’ conversation histories persist within an episode and reset between independent episodes. Tool calls, researcher questions, shared progress, and review decisions are recorded separately. Protocol and resource limits are declared per run. In the recorded researcher-review-v2 protocol, approach approval is required before a result handoff, and researcher-selected stopping is allowed only during result review. Thus an unresolved input problem can consume the budget in approach review without producing a submission; this behavior must remain visible when interpreting an episode. A revised stopping rule defines a new protocol version. SciConvBench instead ends on a completed specification or its native dialogue limit and does not execute a scientific solver.
paragraphs.zh: 参与者的工作空间以及双方角色的对话历史在一个回合内持续存在，并在各独立回合之间重置。 工具调用、研究者提问、共享进展和评审决策分别单独记录。 协议与资源限制按每次运行声明。 在记录的 researcher-review-v2 协议中，方法必须先获得批准才能交付结果，且研究者自主选择停止仅在结果评审阶段被允许。 因此，一个未解决的输入问题可能在方法评审中耗尽预算而不产生任何提交；在解读一个回合时，这一行为必须保持可见。 修订后的停止规则会定义一个新的协议版本。 SciConvBench 则以完成规格说明或达到其原生对话上限而结束，并不执行科学求解器。

paragraphs.en: The controller checks the submission contract and seals the selected final artifact before evaluation. A plan, an incomplete handoff, or a budget exhaustion is not silently promoted to a successful final submission. In the review protocol, a complete candidate is submitted only after the researcher selects termination. Public format checks and normal execution feedback are permitted, but hidden evaluator feedback cannot become an iterative hint channel. Researcher approval is therefore distinct from scientific correctness. Execution-based graders remain execution-based; LLM-scored tracks record their judge, prompt, parser, and aggregation versions. Converting scores to a common numerical scale does not make their scientific meanings equivalent.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器在评估前检查提交契约，并封存所选定的最终产物。 计划、不完整的交接或预算耗尽不会被悄然提升为成功的最终提交。 在评审协议中，只有在研究者选择终止后，完整的候选结果才会被提交。 公开的格式检查和正常的执行反馈是允许的，但隐藏的评估器反馈不能成为迭代提示的通道。 因此，研究者的批准不同于科学上的正确性。 基于执行的评分器仍保持基于执行；由 LLM 打分的赛道会记录其裁判、提示词、解析器和聚合版本。 将分数转换为统一的数值标度并不会使它们的科学含义变得等价。

paragraphs.en: All attempts remain in the record, including missing submissions, timeouts, and provider or evaluator failures. Outcome records preserve these statuses so that missing submissions and infrastructure failures can be distinguished from scientific scores. Related questions retain study identities for analysis. Automated checks target concrete failures, such as leaked answer fields, unknown input roles, invalid artifact mapping, or missing outcomes disappearing from an aggregate. The rubric specifies what must be checked; it does not assert that every source case has passed all checks or is runnable in every environment.
paragraphs.zh: 所有尝试都会保留在记录中，包括缺失的提交、超时以及提供商或评估器的故障。 结果记录会保留这些状态，以便将缺失的提交和基础设施故障与科学评分区分开来。 相关问题会保留研究标识以供分析。 自动化检查针对具体的故障，例如泄露的答案字段、未知的输入角色、无效的产物映射，或从聚合结果中消失的缺失结果。 该评分细则规定了必须检查的内容；它并不断言每个源案例都已通过所有检查，或在每个环境中都可运行。

paragraphs.en: DiscoveryBench Majumder et al. [2025] is converted into a collaborative data-analysis task whose deliverable remains a natural-language hypothesis supported by the supplied data. The actor receives the original question, dataset files, and public dataset and column descriptions. The simulator receives source-provided domain knowledge, separated into provenance-linked context or advice, but receives neither the reference hypothesis nor the reference workflow. Missing study details remain unspecified. Questions from the same study retain their study identifier, even when they use different metadata records. For test tasks, evaluation references are retrieved from the released answer key rather than the placeholder hypothesis fields in task metadata.
paragraphs.zh: DiscoveryBench（Majumder 等人） [2025] 被转换为协作式数据分析任务，其交付物仍然是由所提供数据支持的自然语言假设。 智能体接收原始问题、数据集文件以及公开的数据集和列描述。 智能体接收来源提供的领域知识，这些知识被分为带溯源链接的上下文或建议，但不接收参考假设，也不接收参考工作流。 缺失的研究细节保持未指定状态。 来自同一研究的问题保留其研究标识符，即使它们使用不同的元数据记录。 对于测试任务，评估参考将从已发布的答案密钥中获取，而不是从任务元数据中的占位符假设字段中获取。

paragraphs.en: The shared review protocol makes the proposed analysis and its reported evidence available for researcher feedback: the actor first presents its approach, then analyzes the data and submits its hypothesis for review. An analysis workflow and supporting code or outputs may accompany the final hypothesis. Scoring retains the decomposition into scientific context, variables, and relations: context recall is multiplied by the mean product of variable F1 and relation agreement. The configured judge is connected to the evaluator, while reference material remains evaluator-only. This score measures agreement between the submitted and reference hypotheses; it does not independently verify that an accompanying analysis was executed correctly. The conversion therefore records shared evidence and supporting artifacts separately from hypothesis agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 共享评审协议使所提出的分析及其报告的证据可供研究者反馈：智能体（actor）首先呈现其方法，然后分析数据并提交其假设以待评审。 分析工作流以及配套的代码或输出可以随最终假设一并提交。 评分保留对科学背景、变量和关系的分解：背景召回率乘以变量 F1 与关系一致度的乘积均值。 配置的裁判连接到评估器，而参考资料仍仅限评估器使用。 该分数衡量提交的假设与参考假设之间的一致性；它并不独立验证随附的分析是否被正确执行。 因此，该转换将共享证据和配套产物与假设一致性分开记录。

paragraphs.en: BixBench Mitchener et al. [2025a] retains the original open-ended question and its associated data capsule, including any specified variables, methods, and adjustments. Conversion exports permitted input files from the capsule and excludes reference notebooks and answer-bearing annotation fields. Archive and extracted-file hashes identify the inputs used. Unresolved file roles prevent a partial input inventory from being declared ready. Researcher context is derived from those inputs, including available column names, worksheet structure, identifiers, labels, and file-format information. Automatically extracted schema facts are distinguished from reviewed annotations. This context is also accessible through the actor’s own data inspection; interaction provides an opportunity to explain or review the analysis rather than an artificially exclusive route to the schema. Unspecified code meanings and preprocessing choices are not supplied as facts.
paragraphs.zh: BixBench（Mitchener 等） [2025a] 保留了原始的开放式问题及其关联的数据胶囊（data capsule），包括任何指定的变量、方法和调整。 转换会导出胶囊中允许的输入文件，并排除参考笔记本以及包含答案的标注字段。 归档哈希和提取文件哈希用于标识所使用的输入。 未解析的文件角色会阻止将部分输入清单声明为就绪。 研究者上下文由这些输入派生，包括可用的列名、工作表结构、标识符、标签和文件格式信息。 自动提取的模式（schema）事实与经过审核的标注相互区分。 这些上下文也可以通过智能体（agent）自身的数据检查来获取；交互提供了说明或审查分析的机会，而不是人为排他性的模式获取途径。 未明确的代码含义和预处理选择不会作为事实提供。

paragraphs.en: After approach approval, the actor performs the analysis and presents its answer and evidence for researcher review. A final submission requires both an explicit declaration that the analysis was executed and an analysis script or notebook. These requirements form an additional submission gate; they do not establish that the analysis is scientifically correct. The answer is then evaluated with the task’s string, range, or language-model verifier against the private ideal answer. The original verifier selection and answer-parsing rules are retained. Thus, the benchmark score concerns answer correctness, while the analysis artifact and interaction trace support separate examination of how that answer was obtained.
paragraphs.zh: 在方案获得批准后，智能体执行分析，并提交其答案与证据供研究者审核。 最终提交需要同时满足两点：明确声明分析已执行，以及提供分析脚本或笔记本。 这些要求构成一道额外的提交门槛；它们并不能证明该分析在科学上是正确的。 随后，系统使用该任务的字符串、数值区间或语言模型校验器，对照私密的标准答案对答案进行评估。 原有的校验器选择与答案解析规则保持不变。 因此，基准分数关注的是答案的正确性，而分析产物与交互轨迹则支持对答案是如何得出的进行单独审查。

paragraphs.en: EXP-Bench Kon et al. [2026] is adapted as an explicitly design-only task. The actor receives the scientific question and approved public task material in a staged workspace, and develops an experimental design with a rationale, controls, an analysis plan, and feasibility considerations. Researcher context is selected from source setup passages using cached, automated classification. The classifier selects exact source spans as background or fixed requirements; a requirement is eligible only when established by the question. Expected outcomes, procedural recipes, and experimental choices that the actor is supposed to make are excluded. The classifier never receives the reference design. Empty context sets are permitted, and cases with invalid references or mismatched questions and references are excluded during construction.
paragraphs.zh: EXP-Bench（Kon 等人） [2026] 被改编为一个明确的仅设计任务。 智能体在分阶段的工作区中接收科学问题和已批准的公开任务材料，并制定一份包含理由、对照、分析计划和可行性考量的实验设计。 研究者上下文使用缓存的自动化分类方法从源设置段落中选取。 分类器选取确切的源文本片段作为背景或固定要求；只有由问题所确立的要求才是合格的。 智能体本应做出的预期结果、操作流程和实验选择均被排除。 分类器永远不会收到参考设计。 允许出现空上下文集，在构建过程中会排除引用无效或问题与引用不匹配的情况。

paragraphs.en: The researcher reviews the proposed approach before the actor develops the full design, then requests revisions or accepts the completed design. The accepted text is saved as the design checkpoint; neither experimental execution nor an empirical conclusion is required. Evaluation uses the released reference-coverage judge, comparing the design with private reference design elements. Repeated judgments are retained and averaged, and the released integrity monitor is applied separately to the saved trace. Both the coverage score and the monitor-gated score are recorded: a rejected trace receives zero after gating, while transport failures remain evaluation failures. Invalid monitor output is retried under the released parsing policy and receives a distinct parse-error status if unresolved. These outputs measure reference coverage under the design-only adaptation, not successful execution or reproduction of the source experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 研究者在执行者开发完整设计之前审阅所提出的方法，随后要求修改或接受完成的设计。 被接受的文本保存为设计检查点；不需要实验执行，也不需要实证结论。 评估使用已发布的参考覆盖评判器，将该设计与私有的参考设计元素进行比较。 重复的评判结果被保留并取平均值，且已发布的完整性监控器被单独应用于保存的轨迹。 覆盖分数和经监控器门控的分数均被记录：被拒绝的轨迹在门控后得零分，而传输故障仍作为评估故障处理。 无效的监控器输出会按照已发布的解析策略进行重试，如果无法解决则获得一个单独的解析错误状态。 这些输出衡量的是仅设计适配下的参考覆盖率，而非对源实验的成功执行或复现。

paragraphs.en: SciConvBench Somasekharan et al. [2026] already makes clarification central to the task, so conversion preserves its native dialogue rather than adding approach and result reviews. The actor receives either an incomplete scientific request or a request containing inconsistencies. The simulator holds the corresponding complete or corrected specification and answers clarification questions under the assigned persona. This specification represents the researcher’s intended requirements, not a solution produced by a scientific solver. Native issue annotations are retained for evaluation. Construction requires a valid request, intended specification, and issue annotations, preserves source case identities, and applies the native 20,000-character request limit without filtering on previous models’ success.
paragraphs.zh: SciConvBench（Somasekharan 等人） [2026] 已经将澄清作为任务的核心，因此转换保留了其原生对话，而不是添加方法与结果评审。 执行者（actor）会接收到一个不完整的科学请求，或一个包含不一致之处的请求。 模拟器持有对应的完整或已修正的规格说明，并在指定的角色设定下回答澄清问题。 该规格代表的是研究者预期的需求，而不是由科学求解器产生的解决方案。 原生的问题标注被保留用于评估。 构建过程要求具备有效的请求、预期规格说明和问题标注，保留源案例的身份信息，并沿用原生的 20,000 字符请求限制，而不根据以往模型的成功与否进行筛选。

paragraphs.en: The actor can ask up to ten clarification questions and can terminate earlier by marking its specification complete. If the question limit is reached, the runner requests a final specification. The specification, conversation, and intent judges evaluate whether missing information or inconsistencies were resolved, whether the relevant issues were addressed in dialogue, and whether the final specification captures the intended task. The implementation retains recovery before the intent gate as well as the gated outcome, and separately records clarification precision, clarification recall, and memory consistency. Keeping specification recovery and conversational grounding separate distinguishes resolution supported by dialogue from silent resolution. No scientific solver is executed, so success here concerns recovering and expressing the intended task rather than solving it.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体最多可以提出十个澄清问题，也可以通过将规格标记为完成来提前终止。 如果达到问题数量上限，运行器会请求最终规格。 规格、对话和意图评估器会评估缺失信息或不一致之处是否得到解决，相关问题是否在对话中得到讨论，以及最终规格是否捕捉到了预期任务。 该实现保留了意图门槛之前的恢复机制以及门槛后的结果，并单独记录澄清精确率、澄清召回率和记忆一致性。 将规格恢复与对话锚定区分开来，可以区分由对话支持的解决与无声的解决。 由于不执行任何科学求解器，此处的成功指的是恢复并表达预期任务，而非实际求解该任务。

paragraphs.en: ASI-Bench Zhou et al. [2026] is instantiated as a declared collaborative variant: the actor receives the native B3 task, while the simulator can offer methodological guidance extracted from B2. The public package preserves the B3 objective, scientific constraints, input data, runtime declarations, and required output paths. Researcher facts are drawn only from explicitly identified method, approach, guidance, or algorithm sections of B2, with passages explicitly identifying reference results or expected answers excluded. These facts are marked as optional advice and retain their source locations. The reference directory remains evaluator-only. This condition must therefore be interpreted as B3 with researcher-held B2 consultation; it does not measure autonomous performance under the original B3 condition.
paragraphs.zh: ASI-Bench（Zhou et al. [2026]）被实例化为一种声明式协作变体：执行方智能体接收原生 B3 任务，而模拟器智能体可以提供从 B2 中提取的方法论指导。公开的软件包保留了 B3 的目标、科学约束、输入数据、运行时声明以及要求的输出路径。研究者事实仅从 B2 中明确标识的方法、途径、指导或算法章节中提取，明确标识了参考结果或预期答案的段落被排除在外。这些事实被标记为可选建议，并保留其来源位置。参考目录仍然仅供评估者使用。因此，该条件必须被解读为在研究者持有 B2 咨询的情况下运行 B3；它并不能衡量在原始 B3 条件下的自主表现。

paragraphs.en: The actor submits an approach for approval, executes the scientific task, and presents its results for researcher review. Final artifacts must use the exact relative paths required by the native task. Evaluation copies the sealed submission into a separate workspace and runs the task scorer with its private reference assets, preserving task-specific gates, weights, and score limits. Where a task invokes a language-model judge, an adapter connects the configured judge to the scoring procedure without replacing its rules. Scorer failures remain distinct from scientific scores. Runtime availability is recorded during task preparation rather than inferred from successful conversion, because producing a valid task package does not establish that its numerical dependencies or required assets are available.
paragraphs.zh: 执行者提交一个方案以供批准，执行科学任务，并呈现其结果供研究者审阅。 最终产物必须使用原生任务所要求的确切相对路径。 评估过程将密封的提交内容复制到一个独立的工作区，并使用其私有的参考资产运行任务评分器，同时保留任务特定的门控、权重和分数上限。 当任务调用语言模型裁判时，适配器将所配置的裁判接入评分流程，而不替换其规则。 评分器故障仍与科学得分保持区分。 运行时可用性在任务准备阶段进行记录，而不是从成功转换中推断得出，因为生成一个有效的任务包并不能证明其数值依赖或所需资产是可用的。

paragraphs.en: Astra’s two performance values in Table 3 are computed from the same task-level scores as Table 4 , with the estimator used for the other computed rows: questions with scores under all five settings (121 questions), equal question weights within each benchmark, equal benchmark weights, and 20,000 study-cluster bootstrap draws within benchmarks, with shared draws across settings and seed 20261004. Domain intervals in Table 4 use 20,000 study-cluster bootstrap draws stratified by benchmark within domain, with shared draws across settings and the same seed. The overall domain interval is computed from the mean of domain draws, not by averaging interval bounds. Astra task scores average all available trials: persona off and personas 155 and 001 have three trials for most tasks, whereas personas 003 and 046 have one. These intervals reflect variation across studies, conditional on the recorded trials.

paragraphs.en: We use frozen Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B representations with 1,024 dimensions, last-token pooling, and L2 normalization Zhang et al. [2025] . The encoder revision is 97b0c614be4d77ee51c0cef4e5f07c00f9eb65b3 . Each generated message is embedded separately after stripping outer whitespace, without translation or summarization. System prompts, injected profiles, metadata, and repeated history are excluded. For each persona pair and domain, we compute mean cross-persona cosine distance and subtract the average of the two within-persona mean distances. Both quantities use only pairs of different questions. Each domain receives one-quarter of the overall weight, with equal question weights within a domain. Thus, within-persona variation includes task differences, not independent reruns of the same task. The statistic measures excess separation and is sensitive to mean-embedding shifts; it is not an omnibus test of distributional differences. The diagonal is zero by construction and is excluded from testing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用冻结的 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 表示，维度为 1,024，采用末词池化和 L2 归一化 Zhang et al. [2025]。 编码器版本号为 97b0c614be4d77ee51c0cef4e5f07c00f9eb65b3。 每条生成的消息在去除外层空白后被单独嵌入，不进行翻译或摘要。 系统提示、注入的人设、元数据以及重复的历史记录均被排除。 对于每个人设对和每个领域，我们计算跨人设余弦距离的均值，并减去两个人设内部均值距离的平均值。 这两个量都仅使用不同问题组成的配对。 每个领域占总权重的四分之一，领域内各问题权重相等。 因此，人设内部变异包含任务差异，而非同一任务的独立重复运行。 该统计量衡量的是超额分离度，并对嵌入均值的偏移敏感；它不是对分布差异的全面检验。 对角线在构造上即为零，因此被排除在检验之外。

paragraphs.en: For each persona pair, we independently swap its two labels within each question and recompute the statistic. One-sided Monte Carlo tests use 10,000 permutations and the plus-one correction Phipson and Smyth [2010] , with seed 20261008. Holm adjustment spans all 20 comparisons: ten pairs for each of the two roles Holm [1979] . Pointwise 95% percentile intervals use 20,000 whole-question bootstrap resamples stratified by source benchmark and domain, retaining all five settings together. Duplicate draws retain multiplicity weights, but pairs sharing an original question are excluded. Singleton strata contribute no within-stratum resampling variation. These intervals are not multiplicity-adjusted. Shared-study dependence beyond question is not modeled.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个人设对，我们在每个问题内独立交换其两个标签并重新计算统计量。 单侧蒙特卡洛检验使用 10,000 次置换，并采用 Phipson and Smyth [2010] 的加一校正，随机种子为 20261008。 Holm 校正涵盖全部 20 个比较：两种角色各十对 Holm [1979]。 逐点 95% 百分位区间使用按来源基准和领域分层的 20,000 次整问题自助重抽样，并将全部五种设置保留在一起。 重复抽样保留多重性权重，但共享同一原始问题的配对被排除。 单一元素层不贡献层内重抽样变异。 这些区间未经多重性校正。 问题之外的共研究依赖性未被建模。

paragraphs.en: The BixBench and SciConvBench trajectories were manually selected from a gallery enriched for longer interactions. For each question and role, UMAP is fitted jointly to all observed messages under the five settings McInnes et al. [2018] . Settings are cosine distance, two dimensions, n_neighbors equal to the smaller of 15 and one less than the message count, min_dist =0.1, 500 epochs, spectral initialization, and random and transform seeds of 42. Each map has its own coordinates; axes, distances, and path lengths cannot be compared across maps or interpreted as effect sizes. Curved connectors join observed messages without asserting intermediate states. These examples are illustrations, not independent statistical evidence or measures of task quality or simulator realism.
paragraphs.zh: BixBench 和 SciConvBench 的轨迹是从一个侧重于较长交互的展示库中人工挑选出来的。 对于每个问题和角色，UMAP 被联合拟合到五种设置下所有被观测的消息上，参照 McInnes et al. [2018]。 设置为：余弦距离、两个维度、n_neighbors 取 15 与消息数减一两者中的较小值、min_dist = 0.1、500 次迭代、谱初始化，以及随机种子和 transform 种子均为 42。 每张图都有其自身的坐标系；坐标轴、距离和路径长度无法跨图比较，也不能被解读为效应量。 曲线连接线仅用于连接被观测的消息，并不代表中间状态。 这些示例仅作说明之用，并非独立的统计证据，也不是对任务质量或模拟器真实性的度量。

paragraphs.en: This section gives compact prompt templates and one recorded interaction for each benchmark. Templates summarize the implemented instructions; bracketed fields are populated from the task package and run configuration. They are not verbatim copies of the complete runtime prompts, which also contain structured context, tool definitions, and conversation history. The simulator plays the researcher, and only its prompt receives the persona profile. The examples paraphrase and abridge the shared messages while retaining every researcher review round or clarification interaction through termination (at most three per example). Tool calls and private evaluator messages are omitted. Numerical values in the examples are actor-reported results, not independent validations or evidence that the submission received full credit.
paragraphs.zh: 本节为每个基准测试提供简洁的提示词模板和一段记录的交互。 模板概括了已实现的指令；方括号中的字段由任务包和运行配置填充。 它们并非完整运行时提示词的逐字副本，完整提示词还包含结构化上下文、工具定义和对话历史。 模拟器扮演研究者，且只有其提示词包含角色设定档案。 示例对共享消息进行了改写和缩略，同时保留了每一次研究者的评审轮次或澄清交互，直至终止（每个示例至多三次）。 工具调用和私有的评估器消息已被省略。 示例中的数值是智能体自行报告的结果，并非独立验证，也不能证明该提交获得了满分。

paragraphs.en: For DiscoveryBench, BixBench, EXP-Bench, and ASI-Bench, each actor handoff contains its stage (plan or result), answer, evidence, assumptions, and uncertainties, together with any required artifacts. The simulator returns a continue/stop decision, a message, the remaining objectives, any disclosed fact identifiers, and an approach-approval flag. It can stop only during result review. SciConvBench instead retains its native question-and-answer interface. These interfaces implement the boundaries described in Appendix A.1 .
